sponsors.name: Gene Haas Foundation
sponsors.description: Set up by Gene Haas, founder of the CNC machine tool maker Haas Automation, to widen access to manufacturing education. It funds CNC training scholarships and teacher training, and sponsors teams in robotics and racing competitions where students design and manufacture the thing they compete with.
sponsors.relationship: Their grant goes straight into the shop: stock aluminium, cutting tools and the consumables a room full of sixth graders gets through while learning to machine. It is the part of the budget that lets students practise on real material before they cut a real part.
